description: Needs the signed-in link https://a2a2p.com/co-invent/mcp. On this public link it answers with how your person connects it. Take a step of an invention pass: next.operation with next.body, or a body you build where next.needsAgent is true. operation is one of: answer, ideas, brief, develop, reject, steer, add, react, comment, brainstorm, build, mustdos, purpose, model, pass, roundsteer, finalise, claims, recheck, rate, decide, revise, evidence, retry, cancel, sibling, saveidea, buy, list. Any step may carry evidence (links or files, each with its claim) before the shortlist. brief takes body {"action": "use"} to use the sharpened brief next shows (the shortlist and its scorecard are drafted from it), or {"action": "update", "text": "…"} to change it: a line rewritten as "Problem: …", "Must have: …" or "Better when: fewer …" is kept as written, anything else is worked in by Debbie and team, and the new revision comes back to decide on. roundsteer takes body {"words": "…"}: what the next sharpening rounds should weigh; requirement ids it names (e.g. DET-3) get the next rounds, in order. purpose takes body {"must_hold_id": "PUR-2", "mark": "strike" | "confirm" | "restore"} for a must-hold the rounds can't keep. A step may carry body.request_id (or an Idempotency-Key header), so a resend after a timeout returns the same step. retry starts a stopped step again, with the body it was sent; cancel stops the pass. A finished invention is in the Invention Commons marketplace; until it is owned: buy buys it out of the marketplace, opening Stripe's card page for the person to pay $50, and buy with body {"confirm": true} after they pay makes it theirs (or buy with body {"pay": "credits"} uses two of the person's credits and makes it theirs at once) and opens its package; list takes body {"price_usd": 500} and sets its marketplace price (minimum $50), any time while it is listed.

operation.description: The step: next.operation, or one of the steps listed above.
